verdict: Grade B (44.5) / Discard — Judge REJECT (Gate 3+4+5 fail)
lesson: Expanding-window ICIR-based dynamic factor weighting (Arnott et al. 2019 'Alice in Factorland') fails to generate independent alpha in Korean market. Despite strict PIT compliance (2-month IC lag, C14), the ICIR weights converge to consensus factors (C19 dominant), producing high BM correlation (0.677) and negative FF5 alpha (t=-1.14). S5 VT 18%/DD 7/22 overlay improved OOS retention from 0.13 to 0.55 but cannot fix the fundamental lack of orthogonal signal. Lineage correlation >0.88 to STR_1393/1397/1398 confirms redundancy. Key insight: adaptive weighting of correlated factors produces correlated strategies. Alpha decay is a factor-level problem, not solvable by weighting alone.
